title: Prove It — the unverified thirty-five
brief:
PICTURE AUDIT — filed by Rio (learning coach), 2026-10-16. Not a lesson: an audit tape. Do not teach, explain, or drill on this tape. Cue, pause, reveal — that's all.

GROUND (from state 2026-10-16 — the writer has no file access, so this brief carries it): 35 lexicon rows are rated recognition comfortable/solid but have never passed a production test. Thirty have never been production-tested at all (production field: none; several rest on seed declarations from June, 'declared solid before session one', never verified since). Five more were production-tested only to 'hinted'. This tape splits KNOWN from ASSUMED-KNOWN. Shape per item: an English cue or tiny situation, then a REAL pause — long enough for him to say it aloud — then the Tamil once, clean. Cold-call game energy, Anna's elder-brother voice, wry, Tamil-first around the cues. His rating/note on the tape is the evidence; the picture work happens in the records afterward.

SECTION ONE — never production-tested (30): பிடிக்காது (I don't like) · அவன் (he, informal) · இருக்கு (it is / it exists) · அஞ்சு (five) · மாமா (maternal uncle) · நேத்து (yesterday) · சூப்பர் (super) · அவங்க (they / respectful he-she) · அத்தை (paternal aunt) · சரி (okay) · பார்த்தேன் (I saw / watched) · பெரிய (big) · சின்ன (small) · கிளம்பு (leave / depart) · கொஞ்சம் தண்ணி குடுங்க (please give a little water) · சும்மா சொல்றாங்க (they're just making it up — the dismissal) · என்னமோ பிரச்சனை (some problem or other — the gossip hum) · எப்படி இருக்கீங்க? (how are you, respectful) · வந்துட்டேன் (I've arrived) · அப்புறம் பார்க்கலாம் (see you later) · ஃப்ரீயா விடுங்க (don't worry / let it go) · அலைச்சல் (the hassle, the running-around) · அனுப்புங்க (send it — polite ask) · பிரச்சனை (problem / trouble) · வரல (gloss blank in the lexicon — negative form of வா) · இப்ப (now, mouth form) · பாத்தேன் (I saw — plain past of paaru) · வராது (gloss blank in the lexicon — negative form of வா) · அப்போ (so / then, as a reaction) · எல்லாம் (everything).

SECTION TWO — tested only to 'hinted', finish them (5): தம்பி (younger brother) · உள்ள (inside) · வெளிய (outside) · விட்டுடு (let it go — nee-form) · கிளம்பலாமா? (shall we get going?).

Notes: பார்த்தேன் and பாத்தேன் are both in the inventory — probable double entry; cue both, say nothing about it on tape. Excluded by design: the three EAR ONLY frames (quotative -னு, hearsay -ஆம், youknow-la opener) — recognition-only, not production targets. Rows he produces cold leave the assumed-known pool; rows he can't produce get honestly re-rated in the picture afterward — not re-taught here.
